This asset is a textbook example of structural failure. The front view clearly shows the butterfly with its wings spread wide open. However, the side view shows the butterfly with its wings completely folded, a physically and geometrically separate state. A single, coherent 3D object cannot exist in two different poses simultaneously depending on the camera angle. This is a critical failure for any interactive application. Despite other judges being more lenient, this is a non-negotiable failure point from a UX perspective. The asset is not structurally consistent in any meaningful way.
